scope: Serial loopback HTTP benchmark: aligned V2 SQL in local PGlite versus one-shot local Python CP-SAT. Not live PostgreSQL/Supabase, remote solver transport, or the production flight API.
percentileMethod: Median averages the two central values for even n; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n). With 10 warm samples, p95 is the observed maximum; with 3 cold samples, tails are descriptive only.
